verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents adding documents to an existing index. Its first-party sync integrations (Meilisync, the Rails ActiveRecord auto-sync) imply incremental change propagation rather than full rebuilds. However, no evidence explicitly documents update or delete semantics or near-real-time visibility. One community production report says indexing of 50k constantly changing records fell behind for hours. Another says early indexing couldn't keep up until batch indexing fixed it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of incremental update/delete operations, stated indexing latency or near-real-time guarantees, and independent corroboration under high-churn workloads.

support.subject: As a developer, document adds, updates, and deletes become searchable in near real time without a full reindex
